stem: In paragraphs 4 through 6, what key idea about the Junior Ranger Activity Journal is best supported?

options.label: A
options.text: It includes activities students must complete to earn a badge.

options.label: B
options.text: It describes activities students have done to improve the park.

options.label: C
options.text: It teaches students about the different state parks in Texas.

options.label: D
options.text: It gives students a place to write about their experience.
